title: fix(plugin-list): translate the synthetic "All records" user-filter tab (objectui#13405)
body:
Closes #13405
Clause-②: no

## What changed

A tabs-mode user-filter bar with `showAllRecords` appends a synthetic trailing tab, `{ id: '__all__', … }`, whose label was the literal English string `'All records'`, so a zh-CN list showed it beside translated tabs.

- `packages/plugin-list/src/UserFilters.tsx` (`TabFilters`): the label is now read through `useSafeTranslate()` (the hook `DropdownFilters` in the same file already uses) as `tt('list.userFilters.allRecords', 'All records')`. The translated value is read into a string before the `allTabs` memo, so the memo keys on that string and not on the per-render identity of `tt` (AGENTS.md #10). `TabFilters` is a component, so the hook path needed no workaround.
- One new key, **`list.userFilters.allRecords`**, in all ten packs under `packages/i18n/src/locales/`: en `All records`, zh `全部记录`, ja `すべてのレコード`, ko `전체 레코드`, de `Alle Datensätze`, es `Todos los registros`, fr `Tous les enregistrements`, pt `Todos os registros`, ru `Все записи`, ar `جميع السجلات`. No other key is touched.
- The `__all__` id and the tab's behaviour (no conditions, reported as `_tab: __all__`) are unchanged.
- `.changeset/user-filters-all-records-label-13405.md`: patch for `@object-ui/plugin-list` and `@object-ui/i18n`.

**Why a new key rather than the existing `list.allRecords`:** that key's en value is Title Case (`All Records`). Reusing it would change the English tab label, and the card asks for en to keep reading `All records`. Its translations match the new key's values in every non-en pack.

## Tests

New file `packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/UserFilters.allRecordsLabel-13405.test.tsx`:
- zh: the `filter-tab-__all__` tab reads `全部记录`, and no `All records` text is drawn.
- en: the tab reads `All records`. With no provider, the inline fallback also reads `All records`.
- CONTROL: the authored tabs keep their authored labels in zh and en.
- CONTROL: clicking the tab still emits `[]` and `{ _tab: ['__all__'] }`.
- The controls wait for the catalogue through a separate probe (`t('common.more')`), not through the tab label, so they do not depend on the fix.

Results at head `2fbb3b2033`:
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-list/ packages/i18n/` (under the verify lock): `Test Files 243 passed (243)`, `Tests 2945 passed | 13 skipped (2958)`, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `all-locales-key-parity` + `en-zh-key-parity` run explicitly: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 48 passed (48)`.
- `pnpm check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` (reports "0 en value(s) changed (1 key(s) added, 0 removed)"), `check:i18n-dead-keys` (the new key is not listed), and `check:i18n-designer-parity`: all exit 0.
- `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/plugin-list --filter=@object-ui/i18n`: `Tasks: 15 successful, 15 total`, 0 `error TS`. Both packages ran `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`. Dependents were not type-checked.
- eslint on the touched files: 0 errors. The 30 warnings are existing `no-explicit-any` warnings, none on the changed lines.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: ✅, 1 changeset declared. `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.

**Ablation.** The fix was committed first. Then the label was set back to the literal `'All records'` (on-disk check: injected=1, `allRecordsLabel` uses left=0) and the new file was run. Result: `Tests 1 failed | 4 passed (5)`. Only the zh pin went red; the en, no-provider and both control cases stayed green, as expected. The file was restored with `git checkout HEAD --`: `git diff HEAD` is empty and the blob hash matches HEAD.

## Acceptance notes

- Noted, not filed: the same tab strip's `allowAddTab` affordances are also English literals (`title="Remove tab"`, the `Remove tab …` aria-label, `title="Add filter tab"`, `placeholder="Tab name"` and the `Add tab` button text in `TabFilters`). They are outside this card's surface and their reach was not measured. Carrier: none.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
